title: Kyle Juszczyk: I don't know why Brock Purdy doesn't get respect he deserves

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyle Juszczyk: I don't know why Brock Purdy doesn't get respect he deserves
sources.description: Brock Purdy was an unlikely leading man when he became the 49ers' starting quarterback as a rookie, but the five-year contract extension he signed before last season left no doubt that he'll be playing the role for a long time.
